_about: Round 6 explainer gate spec for qa/gate.py (film-qa gate --spec films/host-studio/explainers/gate_spec.json NUMBERS...). One run per film (whatsapp = him, box A; netflix = her, box B). QA.md says who produces each number and how. complaints: no waiver on these areas. The karma reel's items that do not apply are INFO with the reason in their row; the cloth items are NOT ATTEMPTED (the orchestrator, 07 Nov: her overshirt stays skinned, his tee is Epic's default garment).

lips.eye_onsets.what: the orchestrator's by-eye mouth onset vs audio onset on EVERY on-camera VO line (0-2 f lead, or occluded with what hides it)
lips.eye_onsets.where: every on-camera line of the film
lips.eye_onsets.how: the strip file signed by cc-64d05f6e -> ../reel/r6/eye_onsets.py STRIP --lines <the film's on-camera line ids>
lips.eye_onsets.why: the karma ruling (07 Nov): the render lip measure is invalid, the eye is the judge, line by line

r4: INFO by the orchestrator's ruling (07 Nov): an invalid measure (round 5b: the round-4 control fails too, random sign). agent-01's landmark measure replaces it once validated

head.buzz_rms_deg.why: the operator: 'it must look like it is almost an actual person speaking'; the brief: natural blinks, eyes alive (saccades), head micro-motion

set.clip_px.what: worst frame's presenter-vs-set intersection pixels: Body/Trousers/tee/Overshirt into the Chair or the Desk and back (qa.clip props + pairs, the intersection-edge rule)
set.clip_px.where: every presenter camera, n 8 per shot + the sit/stand-up frames if any
set.clip_px.how: film-ue op qa.clip label=<presenter> sequence=<SEQ> 'props={"Chair":"<chair>","Desk":"<desk>"}' 'pairs=[["Body","Chair"],["Trousers","Chair"],["Chair","Trousers"],["Body","Desk"],["Desk","tee"]]' (core 0ce1c3ae) -> the worst pair px
set.clip_px.why: the brief: no frame where the presenter intersects the chair or desk

set.mic_mouth_px.what: worst frame's mouth pixels the studio mic covers (qa.clip mouth: a 2 cm disc round the lip bones, the mic nearer than the face)
set.mic_mouth_px.where: every presenter camera, every shot (n 8 + the widest head turn)
set.mic_mouth_px.why: the brief: the mic never covers the mouth in any camera

set.props_overlap.what: prop pairs whose bounds interpenetrate (mic arm in the desk, chair in the desk)
set.props_overlap.how: film-ue op qa.overlaps labels=[set props] ignore_pairs=[resting contacts]
set.props_overlap.why: clean set; confirm a hit with a still

r4: INFO for the explainers: no round-4 reference exists (new set and cameras); shot.cameras_ok and the orchestrator's review cover a wrong view

shot.exposure_jump_stops.what: worst frame-to-frame change of the presenter's face-box exposure inside a shot (auto-exposure pumping, a light popping)
shot.exposure_jump_stops.where: every presenter shot (final frames, on the box)
shot.exposure_jump_stops.how: qa_av.py exposure FRAMES --shots shots.json --box <face box> (on the box: face data)
shot.exposure_jump_stops.why: the brief: exposure stable; 0.05 stops is below what reads as a flicker

shot.exposure_drift_stops.what: worst drift of the 12-frame moving average of the face-box exposure inside a shot
shot.exposure_drift_stops.why: a slow eye-adaptation drift reads as a dimmer on the face

audio.lufs_err_lu.what: |integrated loudness - (-14 LUFS)| of the delivered cut

audio.true_peak_dbtp.what: true peak of the delivered cut

captions.text_match.what: the burnt/side-car captions' words in order equal the VO lines' words (case, punctuation ignored)
captions.text_match.why: the brief: captions match the VO

captions.onset_ms.what: worst |first caption start - VO line start|
captions.onset_ms.why: a caption more than ~5 frames off its line reads as out of sync

facts.sourced.what: every number the VO says is softened (over, about, nearly...) or has a sourced claim in facts.json
facts.sourced.why: the brief: facts must be right; numbers softened unless a source pins them

deliver.format_ok.what: 1920x1080 square pixels (16:9), 24/25/30 fps, one video + one 48 kHz audio stream

deliver.qc_ok.what: film-post qc on the cut passes (no black or frozen runs, duration = EDL, captions in the safe area)
deliver.qc_ok.how: film-post qc CUT.mp4 --edl X.edl --captions X.srt -o qc.json -> pass
deliver.qc_ok.why: the karma cut's final_qa, for the explainers
